item_short_desc: Rothco’s 72 inch Boot Laces come in a convenient 3-pack, making them the perfect replacement for any tactical or law enforcement boot. Constructed with long-lasting polyamide (with black laces made of nylon), these tactical boot laces offer exceptional durability and strength. The heat-formed tips prevent fraying, ensuring that the laces maintain their integrity even under heavy use. Each lace measures 72 inches in length, providing ample length to secure your boots tightly and comfortably.
